STAGE 10: Tony Fairclough 16:20 (2nd fastest). It took just 16 minutes and 20 seconds for Tony to prove that he is back into our 'A' teams with a vengeance, putting us back into 2nd spot.
On stage ten Tony Fairclough took us past Smallheath and into 6th place once more, having to put in a determined effort to hold off Kirby of Cardiff.
The Belgrave trio of John Stow (27), Colin Pearson (24) and Tony Fairclough (18) plough their way through the Surrey County Cross County Championship and help take the team to 2nd place.

With Tony Fairclough suffering from a heavy cold and joining the supporters, it was left to a still far from fit Bill Kerr, straight from a decorating session at home and still with paint in his hair, to complete our scoring team.

At the Windmill Brian Marmion had taken the lead and, moving well, thought he would be able to hang on to the finish but as always the middle and back markers begin to work through from here on and by the time the stump of the old elm was reached at the final turn into Southside it was Tony Fairclough all the way.
Several old faces made a welcome re-appearance and rumour has it that old 'TK' will be battling it out with Tony Fairclough this winter. John Stow made a welcome return to clock fastest of the day
Colin Pearson (84) uses the jumping low level pass to send Tony Fairclough on his way.
